lines.text: Why would a car ramp that holds 25000 pounds still be a death trap?
ai: a car up on black plastic ramps in a dark garage with dramatic light

lines.text: He crushes eleven brands in a press and the 60 dollar plastic ramps take almost 25000 pounds.
ai: a hydraulic press crushing a black plastic car ramp

lines.text: That's almost eight times their rating because the plastic ribs spread the load like a honeycomb.
ai: macro of a golden honeycomb structure under pressure
black plastic ribs inside a car ramp cutaway
a honeycomb holding a heavy steel weight

lines.text: Meanwhile a pair of steel ramps folds under a tractor.
ai: a steel car ramp bending under a heavy tractor tire

lines.text: Because thin steel buckles once it starts to bend while the ribs keep sharing the load.
ai: a thin steel sheet buckling in slow motion
plastic ribs flexing and holding a heavy load

lines.text: So crushing is the one thing you don't need to worry about.
ai: a giant hydraulic press resting idle in a dim factory
a person relaxing next to a car ramp

lines.text: On smooth concrete almost every ramp slides and two shoot out from under a car.
ai: a car ramp sliding across smooth concrete with motion blur

lines.text: That's friction because a climbing or braking tire shoves the ramp forward and one rubber stop can't hold it.
ai: a car tire pushing a plastic ramp forward on concrete
a small rubber stopper slipping on a floor macro

lines.text: A damp towel underneath adds grip and helped most of them which is a free fix anyone can do.
ai: a damp towel under a car ramp on concrete

lines.text: So check for grip and set the parking brake before you crawl under.
ai: a hand pulling up a car parking brake lever
a mechanic on a creeper next to a car on ramps

lines.text: So is your car ramp a death trap?
ai: a car up on black plastic ramps in a dark garage with dramatic light
